overlayEntry.notes: Re-reviewed 2026-07-27. The YieldFi yUSD token terms (BVI law, series-limited contractual certificates) were re-fetched and are unchanged: a Market Neutral series deployed into delta-neutral positions (private LP deals, hedged carry, basis, funding-rate spreads across whitelisted protocols) with a binding exposure constraint of <1% directional delta, NAV computed as (Series Assets - Series Liabilities) / tokens outstanding at least twice weekly on Chainlink or equivalent oracles, ForDeFi as MPC custodian, and a T+2 redemption target priced at the minimum of request- and processing-time NAV. hedgeCoverageRatio 0.99 remains the documented-policy lower bound implied by the <1% delta constraint, not an observed measurement; the manager publishes no position-level hedge state. marginBufferPct is 0: re-measured on Ethereum at block 25627267 (hash 0xecdb9930d4b1c62592697895f59916d5d9f5477cf1d1178be98cd75a911490e9, timestamp 2026-07-27T22:54:35Z) via eth_call on https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com — totalAssets() = 10,696,286.730934 USDC against share liability at the vault's own convertToAssets(1e18) = 0.998453 USDC/share times totalSupply() = 10,712,859.371583354 shares = 10,696,286.578136 USDC, a +0.152798 USDC (+0.0000014%) epsilon; all three values are bit-identical to the 2026-07-20 read at block 25572118, so no deposits, redemptions, or NAV updates touched the vault in the intervening week. Assets equal token claims at NAV by construction and no excess-capital buffer exists. lossAbsorptionShare is 0 as a documented structural absence: the terms establish series-limited recourse with an explicit no-top-up clause, a waterfall of costs then fees then tokenholder redemptions, and no insurance fund or junior tranche. The terms' own risk-limits section still lists margin buffers, liquidation policies, and rebalancing frequency as 'n/a' while permitting leverage and borrowing, and allocations across Pendle, Morpho, Silo, private credit, and market-neutral sleeves remain unpublished. fundingBasisStress was searched again on 2026-07-27: the token terms contain no funding-rate stress scenario or policy beyond the delta constraint, the Prime Transparency & Analytics documentation describes VaR/CVaR, exposure, leverage and liquidity-ladder analytics only in product terms, and the live v2.yield.fi/transparency dashboard is a client-rendered Next.js app whose backing API is not publicly documented and exposes no pinnable itemized funding-stress or margin figures — so fundingBasisStress stays bounded (component omitted). Grades: venueAndCustody limited (ForDeFi named as MPC custodian in enforceable token terms, corroborated by the verified on-chain vault, but no custody attestation or account-structure disclosure); hedgeReconciliation limited (documented <1% delta policy and twice-weekly NAV publication, but no position-level hedge reconciliation); marginAndLiquidation limited (margin/liquidation policies documented as n/a while leverage is permitted — the measured zero buffer is a documented structural property, not a published margin policy); unwindCapacity limited (T+2 redemption target at min-of-NAV with documented delay discretion); lossAbsorption limited (documented no-top-up, series-limited waterfall — a pinned structural absence of loss-absorbing capital). NOT established: current strategy allocations and venue weights (venueShares omitted), any funding-stress or margin policy beyond the delta constraint, the ForDeFi custody account structure, and the identity or track record of the strategy manager behind the Manager contract.
